title: App icons / Usage

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Separate product recognition from corporate authorship so people understand both what an app is and who provides it.
strategic_value: Context-specific icon sizing and clear separation from the IBM mark can prevent product symbols from competing with the master brand.
demonstration: Sizing specimens, containers, color-theme comparisons and explicit icon-versus-logo examples lead into product and marketing applications.
practical_value: Choose icon size and background theme for the context, then check that the icon is not being used as a logo.

content_islands.name: Sizing and alignment
content_islands.spec: Place productive and expressive size specimens before optical-centering examples; the specification table is captured separately.

content_islands.name: Containers and clearance
content_islands.spec: Compare accepted circular or square containers with rejected shapes, then show operating-system cases and quarter-grid padding.

content_islands.name: Color themes
content_islands.spec: Use four backgrounds and a lookup table to distinguish light, dark and monochromatic themes.

content_islands.name: Icon versus logo
content_islands.spec: Pair permitted and rejected lockups, product headers, slides, communications and merchandise.

content_islands.name: Applications
content_islands.spec: Close with product, app-store and marketing examples.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source requires communications featuring app icons to remain visibly authored by the IBM master brand.
reference_purposes.Expression: The icon family adapts between luminous and monochrome treatments on different backgrounds.
reference_purposes.Application: Examples show native-OS containers, marketing hero use and context-specific sizes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: App icons are not logos; the guide rejects icon-name lockups, product headers and intro/outro sign-offs, while allowing hero graphics.

ingredient.name: App icon versus logo
ingredient.role: Identify a product without creating a competing brand signature.
ingredient.application: Keep icon and product name visually separate; retain clear hierarchy when both an icon and the IBM logo appear. Use approved themes for the background.
ingredient.scope: Rules distinguish product/marketplace identification, marketing hero graphics and native-OS containers. App icons must not replace logos or become sign-offs.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
